description: Check the reputation of a token DEPLOYER wallet on Base. Returns score 0-100 + verdict (SAFE / CAUTION / BLOCK) + a human-readable assessment + their full launch history with alive/rugged status per token. Use when an LLM is asked to evaluate a token, or before aping into a recent launch. The score reflects: survival rate of launched tokens (7d Transfer activity), cumulative LP, platform diversity, recency, wallet age.

address.description: Deployer wallet address (the wallet that called the factory).

name: mainstreet_deployer
